claims.claim: The work of fabrication is guided by a model that precedes the actual work process and remains intact to survive the finished product.
claims.supporting_excerpt: The actual work of fabrication is performed under the guidance of a model in accordance with which the object is constructed... the image or model whose shape guides the fabrication process not only precedes it, but does not disappear with the finished product, which it survives intact, present, as it were, to lend itself to an infinite continuation of fabrication.

claims.claim: The process of making is entirely determined by the categories of means and end, culminating in a durable end product rather than the biological exhaustion characteristic of labor.
claims.supporting_excerpt: The process of making is itself entirely determined by the categories of means and end. The fabricated thing is an end product in the twofold sense that the production process comes to an end in it (“the process disappears in the product,” as Marx said) and that it is only a means to produce this end.

definitions.definition: The act of multiplying something that already possesses a relatively stable, relatively permanent existence in the world, distinct from mere repetition.
A process urged upon and remaining subject to the biological cycle, marking the cyclical nature of labor.

distinctions.distinction: Multiplication multiplies something that already possesses a relatively stable and permanent existence in the world, whereas repetition is urged upon and remains subject to the biological cycle of bodily needs and wants.

Fabrication is guided by an external model and determined by means and ends to produce a durable entity, whereas labor is driven by the biological urgencies of the life process and results in products that immediately become means for consumption and reproduction.

must_not_be_lost: The distinction between mental images and bodily sensations.
The connection between the permanence of the model of fabrication and Plato's doctrine of eternal ideas.
parsed.segment_function: An analysis of the role of models, means and ends, and the distinct nature of multiplication versus repetition in fabrication compared to labor.
unresolved_context: Discussion of modern psychology and subjective interpretations of mental images versus physical location.
